displayPattern: 7-segment display on a *CVC96 or *MVC96 two-stage furnace covered by IOG-2015L, including Amana AMVC96 and ACVC96: EEF
meaning: Auxiliary limit switch (condensate switch) is open. The furnace fails to operate.
diySteps: Do not bypass the condensate switch to get heat
Technician: check the evaporator drain pan, trap and piping, which is the corrective action in the chart
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. EEF is the condensate switch, which is a common cold-weather shutdown when the drain path is blocked or frozen.
sourceTitle: Amana and Goodman *CVC96 / *MVC96 two-stage furnace installation instructions (IOG-2015L)
